risks: Five new files plus two shared UI seams are insufficient unless foundation owners provide authenticated transport, durable native create, workflow receipts, provenance and event registration. Silent scope expansion or simulation would violate packet.
Published RS-DOC-01 expects collaborative Page/Drive/Discussion and RS-AUT-05 relies on earlier automation foundations; six LSX edges must not be mistaken for proof those hidden gates are accepted.
Existing command permissions/context gating and ResourceProviderRegistry search are not server ACL. Never treat a visible command or search result as an execution/share grant.

automationGraphRevision is an optimistic FNV token, not manifest integrity; compile/save graph can alter canonical runtime actions and cannot implement inert preview or immutable workflow publication.

Tiptap official preprocessing globally changes math/currency in code/action fences; postprocess replaces arbitrary currency markers. Fix through accepted lossless bridge and precise shared patch, not stripping unrecognized blocks.
Read-only Tiptap still includes Image and render extensions; unreviewed templates require policy-safe asset rendering and no unapproved external/private fetches, not merely editable=false.
A UI createNote then saveNote sequence is not one durable template receipt. Crash/replay may duplicate documents or children unless logical origins are persisted by existing owners.

Flushing a dirty current note while merely opening or previewing gallery violates zero-mutation acceptance. Flush only on explicit confirmation/navigation and preserve unsaved draft on cancel/failure.

Root integration can change inspected lines and bytes. Recorded Notes/editor generation already differs from published baseline; do not overwrite root work or reuse stale hashes as committed evidence.
Template licenses and private assets need explicit current audience authorization; manifest declarations cannot install capabilities, grant access or publish workflows.

Full DoD includes six independent proof lanes and seeded semantic failure sensitivity. Report verification, source-only tests, screenshots or queued/provider receipts alone are not feature completion.
